text: {"danger_level":"red","danger_reason":"This location is in a red zone with mandatory evacuation for everyone (inside and outside buildings) due to a Car (500 lb) explosion threat.","main_move":"MOVE_AWAY","main_move_text":"Move away beyond the safe distance","where_to_go":"Go to Safe point outside the danger zone to the E, which is 474 meters away (about 6.3 walking minutes).","do_now":[{"text":"Evacuate immediately from inside the building to the outside safe zone.","advice_ids":["exp.red_evacuate"]},{"text":"Move out of the line of sight of the incident scene and stay away from windows.","advice_ids":["exp.line_of_sight"]},{"text":"Keep unauthorized personnel away from the area.","advice_ids":["exp.keep_away"]}],"do_not":[{"text":"Do not gather at windows, doorways, or outdoors to view the scene, as secondary explosions may occur.","advice_ids":["exp.secondary"]},{"text":"Do not approach the source or re-enter the danger zone.","advice_ids":["exp.red_evacuate"]}],"if_you_are":[{"situation":"Outdoors, in a vehicle, or needing assistance","text":"Stay upwind, uphill and/or upstream from the hazard.","advice_ids":["exp.upwind"]}],"call":["112 - National emergency number","108 - Ambulance","101 - Fire and rescue"],"confidence":"medium","confidence_reason":"The evacuation zone is based on standard bomb standoff charts, but multiple data gaps exist regarding satellite layers and unverified hospital emergency capacity.","unknowns":["Satellite layers (population, building height, land height) not loaded.","Hospitals shown are mapped major hospitals; their emergency services, capacity and current status are not verified.","Bomb stand-off distances are estimates based on test data; the chart states they do not guarantee safety and that the area near the evacuation distances is still potentially dangerous.","Building distances assume typical US commercial construction; Indian buildings may perform differently."],"valid_while":[]}
